result.instructions: Tools for Gorelo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tickets are open and unassigned right now?"; "Which managed devices are offline for the client Acme?"; "Which invoices are overdue, and how much is owed per client?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gorelo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gorelo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gorelo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gorelo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. gorelo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gorelo_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: create a service ticket. Needs status_id, group_id and type_id (use gorelo_list_ticket_statuses, gorelo_list_groups, gorelo_list_ticket_types). Set send_created_email true only if the contact must get a 'ticket created' email. API: POST /v1/tickets.

description.description: Ticket body as HTML. Plain text is wrapped in a paragraph. Send < and > as < and >.

send_created_email.description: Email the contact that the ticket was created (default false).

tools.name: gorelo_update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a ticket (status, priority, assignee, title, tags). Only the fields you send change. Each change notifies and logs as in the app. Changing the client clears the ticket's contact and assets. API: PATCH /v1/tickets/{ticketId}.

tag_ids.description: Replaces the whole tag list; [] clears it.

tools.name: gorelo_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Add a ticket comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to a ticket's main thread. A 'public' comment is a reply the client sees and may be emailed to them; a 'private' comment is an internal note. Do not retry after an unclear error: that can post twice. API: POST /v1/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

body.description: Comment body as HTML. Send < and > in text as < and >.

visibility.description: public = visible to the client; private = internal note.

tools.name: gorelo_update_alert_status
tools.title: Update an alert status
tools.description: WRITE: dismiss an alert, restore it to New, or link it to an open ticket (status 'ticketed' needs ticket_id). The change applies to the alert's whole stack, as in the app. API: PATCH /v1/alerts/{alertId}.

ticket_id.description: Open ticket id (uuid). Required when status is ticketed.

tools.name: gorelo_log_time_entry
tools.title: Log time on a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: log work time against a ticket (or a project task). Give any two of started_on, ended_on and actual_hours (the API derives the third). Billing role, work type and billable status default from the ticket. Do not retry after an unclear error: that can log twice. API: POST /v1/time-entries.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id (uuid). Send this or task_id.

task_id.description: Project task id (guid). Send this or ticket_id.

started_on.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of the work.

ended_on.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of the work.

user_id.description: Technician id the time belongs to.
